description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for storing and querying Large Language Model (LLM) cost records in a MongoDB database. It includes schema definitions, indexes for efficient filtering, and a pre-update hook.

classes.name: LLMCost
classes.description: Mongoose model representing LLM cost records with various indexed fields for efficient querying.

methods.name: pre('findOneAndUpdate')
methods.description: A Mongoose middleware hook that updates the 'updated_at' timestamp before executing a findOneAndUpdate operation.
